question_en: An Industrial Electrician is assigned to “Maintains grounding systems”. Under which official RSOS Task is this activity classified?
options: Installs and maintains electric heating systems and controls
Installs and maintains bonding, grounding and ground-fault protection and detection systems
explanation_en: The official Industrial Electrician Task Matrix places B-11.02 under B-11: Installs and maintains bonding, grounding and ground-fault protection and detection systems.
explanation_es: La matriz oficial de Industrial Electrician ubica B-11.02 dentro de B-11: Installs and maintains bonding, grounding and ground-fault protection and detection systems.

question_en: A 4-pole AC machine runs at 1800 rpm synchronous speed. What frequency corresponds to this speed?
explanation_en: Use frequency = poles × speed / 120 = 4 × 1800 / 120 = 60 Hz.
explanation_es: Usa frecuencia = polos × velocidad / 120 = 60 Hz.

question_en: A 6-pole machine is supplied at 60 Hz. What synchronous speed corresponds to this relationship?
explanation_en: Rearrange f = poles × speed / 120: speed = 120f/poles = 1200 rpm.
explanation_es: Despeja f = polos × velocidad / 120: velocidad = 1200 rpm.

question_en: A three-phase transformer maintenance test has been completed. What is the correct basis for evaluating the result?
options: Previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_en: RSOS B-15.06 requires comparison with previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_es: B-15.06 exige comparar con resultados previos, especificaciones del fabricante y documentación de commissioning.

question_en: Which is a three-phase transformer winding configuration explicitly listed in the RSOS?
explanation_en: The RSOS lists open-delta among three-phase transformer winding configurations.
explanation_es: El RSOS lista open-delta entre las configuraciones de transformadores trifásicos.

question_en: Which test is listed for low-voltage three-phase transformers?
explanation_en: The RSOS range lists insulation, voltage, polarity, turn-ratio and thermographic tests.
explanation_es: El RSOS lista pruebas de aislamiento, voltaje, polaridad, relación de vueltas y termografía.

question_en: A cable circuit has an intermittent fault. According to the RSOS maintenance process, what should be determined after obtaining the malfunction history and selecting test equipment?
options: The source, type and location of the fault.
explanation_en: C-16.02 requires determining the source of malfunction and the type/location of the fault using assessment and test results.
explanation_es: C-16.02 exige determinar la fuente del mal funcionamiento y el tipo/ubicación de la falla.

question_en: After repairing a conductor, what identification action is required by the RSOS?
options: Label repaired conductors and corresponding terminals according to drawings/specifications.
No identification is required after testing.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires repaired conductors and corresponding terminals to be labelled to drawings and specifications.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige etiquetar conductores reparados y terminales correspondientes según planos y especificaciones.

question_en: What should be inspected when checking conductors for excessive heating?
explanation_en: C-16.02 specifically requires inspection of terminations and testing conductors for excessive heating.
explanation_es: C-16.02 exige inspeccionar terminaciones y probar conductores por calentamiento excesivo.

question_en: Which item is listed as a component associated with conductor/cable installation?
explanation_en: Heat shrink is included in the RSOS range of variables for conductor/cable components.
explanation_es: Heat shrink aparece en el rango de variables del RSOS para componentes de conductores/cables.

question_en: Which skill is explicitly included in C-16.01 procedures?
explanation_en: The RSOS learning objectives include procedures to terminate conductors and cables.
explanation_es: El RSOS incluye procedimientos para terminar conductores y cables.

question_en: A wiring device has failed. What is the correct replacement basis according to the RSOS?
options: A component from a different voltage class.
explanation_en: C-17.04 requires selection of an OEM or equivalent replacement component.
explanation_es: C-17.04 exige seleccionar un componente OEM o equivalente.

question_en: After replacing a defective wiring device, what must be done before returning it to service?
options: Test branch circuitry and the wiring device.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires post-repair testing and verification of function.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige pruebas después de la reparación y verificación de funcionamiento.

question_en: Which item is listed as a wiring device in the RSOS?
explanation_en: Timers are included in the RSOS range of wiring devices.
explanation_es: Los temporizadores están incluidos en el rango de dispositivos de cableado.

question_en: Which diagnostic equipment is specifically listed for maintaining wiring devices?
explanation_en: The RSOS lists multimeters and thermographic imaging devices for this task.
explanation_es: El RSOS lista multímetros y dispositivos de imagen termográfica.

question_en: What should documentation show after maintenance changes to wiring devices?
explanation_en: C-17.04 requires documentation to be updated to reflect changes.
explanation_es: C-17.04 exige actualizar la documentación para reflejar los cambios.
